issues.summary: Binary families (DbBinary/DbLongBinary/DbVarBinary) were not handled, so a hex token could fall into the numeric-regex branch and be flagged invalid.
issues.resolution: Accepted-with-clarification: unreachable in the generator (binary columns are omitted upstream via IsBinary before the row loop; Format has no binary branch). Added a defensive `if (IsBinary(typeCode)) return false;` guard to the public predicate + a theory test (DEADBEEF/0102FF/AB). R3 VERIFIED.
